description: History-based sales forecast adapter with cold-start gating and rolling-origin evaluation

verification_details.cold_start_gate: Under 14 days of trading history (5 days tested), status is cold_start, data_quality_gate is insufficient_history, and statistical forecast is withheld.
verification_details.rolling_origin_evaluation: With 15 days of trading history, rolling-origin backtest evaluates Naive vs 7-day Simple Moving Average, calculates MAE in paisa, and provides calibrated 7-day projection with uncertainty interval.
verification_details.synthetic_disclaimer: Forecast is clearly labeled as history-based projection calibrated on observed merchant daily sales.
